# Packages whose version can change the numbers in the committed chains under
# data/, rather than only whether the code runs.
#
# The sessions load those chains instead of regenerating them, because a full
# PMMH run takes hours. So the site render proves a bump did not break any code
# path, and proves nothing about whether the sampler still produces the
# committed draws. Two workflows read this list:
#
#   chains-current.yml          fails a pull request that changes compat for one
#                              of these without regenerating the chains
#   compathelper_automerge.yml  keeps these off auto-merge, so a person decides
#
# Regenerating is a cluster job, not a CI job: scripts/generate_pmcmc_seitl.jl
# and generate_pmcmc_seit4l.jl each take many hours at 256 particles, against a
# six hour limit per CI job.
#
# One name per line. Add a package when its version can move the draws.

Turing
AdvancedPS
AdvancedVI
SSMProblems
GeneralisedFilters
DifferentialEquations
JumpProcesses
Distributions
